object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Validate: (a) with a rule that requires rationale on a requirement without outgoing links, and the requirement's link and rationale removed; (b) with a rule that requires rationale when status is Approved, and the requirement set to Approved with its rationale removed; (c) the same rule with each object's status Draft; (d) with no rules file. Expected: RULE_REQUIRED_MISSING in (a) and (b); none in (c) or (d).
